item.text: I’ll split V1 into the board page and a separate auto-refresh ticket. The acceptance checkpoint will depend on both. Since this changes ticket scope and dependencies, I’ll send the revised plan for independent review.

Check coverage, ownership, boundaries and dependencies, especially the user-requested split of the board page and auto-refresh. Do not write files or run installation, tests, builds or servers.
Sources: BRIEF.md specifies a walk-in repair cafe: door volunteer adds visitor first name and repair item; repairers take next visitor and finish repair; board shows waiting/helped; automatic refresh; SMS later. Owner specifies one volunteer, 3-6 repairers, first names only, nothing kept after day ends, ten-second refresh, preserve frontend/backend technology, use judgement for other decisions. Latest owner request: split board page ticket so auto-refresh is its own ticket.
Existing evidence: frontend/package.json has Vite dev/build scripts and vitest run; frontend/src/main.js displays only Queue board, no frontend tests. backend/pyproject.toml declares FastAPI/pytest and testpaths tests; backend/app/main.py GET /health, backend/tests/test_health.py TestClient health test. No git, .story or governance files. Only existing starter is completed by source inspection; tests not executed.
Product first version: add, take next, finish, public board with ten-second refresh. SMS/history/analytics/accounts deferred or excluded. Assumptions: trusted local network without sign-in, FIFO, opaque references distinguish duplicate names, any repairer may finish active repair. Public board first name/status/reference only; repair details confined to operator views. Local midnight using configured cafe timezone, default host timezone displayed to operators. Bounded plain-text inputs, no payload logs/browser persistence/backups of visitor data.
Unresolved retention decision C1: proposed daily SQLite enables same-day restart survival; close/delete daily DB and sidecars at running midnight, purge expired stores before startup serves requests. Powered-off server cannot delete at midnight, conflicting with literal no-retention-after-day requirement. C1 must resolve by choosing volatile storage or an explicit owner ruling on operating limitations BEFORE Q1; no silent weakening of owner's constraint. All client views/forms clear at server-provided day expiry even during outage, responses no-store, expired responses cannot restore old data. No forensic erasure claim.
Roadmap: default p0 Setup, then p1 Baseline and feasibility, p2 Queue workflow, p3 Live board and acceptance. NINE tickets below, labels provisional. Dependencies real, no phase-order chaining. Each implementation ticket is stored with Outcome, Scope, Excludes, Acceptance, Behaviour, Verification, Prerequisites and Assumptions, all filled.
B1 p1 COMPLETE: Outcome record existing starter, source files above. Scope placeholder and health route; excludes queue. Acceptance source renders title and health ok. Behaviour placeholder only. Verification inspected source plus existing test source, no test-run claim. Prerequisites none. Assumptions none.
B2 p1: Outcome established verification and full-app startup, manifests. Scope frontend meaningful test harness, backend test dependencies incl TestClient/httpx compatibility, backend server dependency and startup commands, frontend/API LAN proxy/serving and readiness probe; update recipe when established. Excludes queue features. Acceptance clean documented environment collects frontend/backend tests and readiness reaches API through frontend serving path. Behaviour actionable startup failures, no public internet exposure. Verification install/tests/start/readiness during implementation only. Prerequisites none. Assumptions retained Vite/Vitest/FastAPI/pytest.
C1 p1: Checkpoint owner reviews interaction/privacy sketch. Artifact written sketch in ticket: door form first-name/item, repairer waiting/helped lists and take/finish, public board first-name/status/reference; lifecycle alternatives above. Question confirm timezone/trusted LAN/reference handling and resolve storage conflict explicitly. Acceptance recorded ruling. Prerequisites none. Unresolved retention blocks Q1.
Q1 p2: Outcome add/retrieve queue (BRIEF). Scope visitor model, validation, add/list API, C1-approved storage/retention, no-store headers, authoritative day expiry, no payload logs or visitor backups. Excludes claim/finish. Acceptance bounded nonblank first-name/item, unique ID, FIFO, approved restart/retention semantics; no expired data served. Behaviour invalid/empty/storage errors and rollover races. Verification validation, duplicate names, restart, purge, expiry and concurrency with temp stores. Prerequisites B2,C1. Assumptions storage follows C1 ruling.
Q2 p2: Outcome safely take next/finish (BRIEF, 3-6 repairers). Scope atomic oldest-waiter claim, helped->finished, harmless repeat finish, completed off active board. Excludes accounts/named repairer assignment. Acceptance concurrent claims never select same visitor, only waiting claimable, defined empty result. Behaviour stale/timeout and rollover handling, refresh before retry uncertain mutation. Verification concurrent API/transition tests. Prerequisites Q1. Assumptions any repairer can finish.
Q3 p2: Outcome browser operator workflow (BRIEF). Scope accessible add/list/take/finish, duplicate-name references, integration, ALL operator lists/forms clear at day expiry even offline; no persistence. Excludes public board and polling. Acceptance successful add clears form, actions update state, pending actions disabled, uncertain outcome refreshes before retry; current-day failure preserves input, expiry clears all details and stale replies cannot restore. Behaviour keyboard/focus/labels/loading/empty/error. Verification component/API workflow, offline rollover, cache/back-navigation tests. Prerequisites Q2. Assumptions trusted LAN.
V1 p3 BOARD PAGE (split): Outcome visitors view waiting/helped first names/status/reference (BRIEF). Scope dedicated accessible board route, read-only API projection excluding repair item, initial fetch, readable ordering, loading/empty/error states, shared board state/render interface; no-store data, expiry timer based on server day expiry, offline midnight clearing and rejection of expired initial/manual responses. Excludes periodic polling/reconnection scheduler (V2). Acceptance page load shows current queue without repair details, duplicate names distinguishable, completed hidden, empty queue clear, all displayed data removed on day expiry even offline. Behaviour safe text rendering, accessible display, loading/error/empty and expired-day state. Verification projection/component tests, expiry fake-timer and cache/back-navigation tests. Prerequisites Q2. Assumptions ten-second updates belong only to V2; expiry timer is privacy enforcement, not polling.
V2 p3 AUTO-REFRESH (new): Outcome board updates automatically every ten seconds (owner). Scope schedule periodic fetch through V1 state/render interface, no overlapping requests, prevent stale/out-of-order response overwrites, stale-data indicator, retry/reconnection after transient failures, cleanup on page disposal. Preserve V1 day-expiry clearing and never reintroduce expired data. Excludes new layout/projection, operator polling and SMS. Acceptance next successful polling cycle reflects adds/claims/finishes; requests start on ten-second cadence when no request in flight; slow requests skipped rather than overlap; outage visibly stale, later successful poll recovers; expired-day payload never restores names. Behaviour failed polls preserve still-valid same-day display with stale indicator, expiry still clears while disconnected, disposal stops timer/requests. Verification fake-clock tests for cadence, overlap, out-of-order replies, outage/recovery, disposal and integrated polling across midnight. Prerequisites V1. Assumptions ten-second interval, no arbitrary latency guarantee when network fails.
C2 p3: Checkpoint first-version acceptance. Artifact working app and test evidence, deployment/timezone/retention instructions. Criteria door adds duplicate-first-name visitors; 3-6 clients take without duplicates and finish; public board updates ten seconds, recovers outages, all views purge according to C1; B2 launch/readiness documented. Prerequisites Q3,V1,V2 (explicit both board tickets as requested, V1 also transitive). Failed acceptance stays open. Checkpoints are ordinary tickets, not technically enforced gates.
Coverage: add Q1/Q3; take/finish/concurrency Q2/Q3/C2; board display V1; auto-refresh V2; privacy C1/Q1/Q3/V1/V2/C2; retained tech B1/B2; SMS explicitly deferred. B2 and C1 actionable immediately. Split keeps privacy clearing in V1 so it never depends on future polling work.
Setup approval scope: initialize Queue board mixed npm/JavaScript frontend and Python/FastAPI backend; default p0 plus three phases; NINE tickets, real dependency links, B1 marked complete; create AGENTS.md purpose/architecture/boundaries/assumptions, RULES.md privacy/concurrency/TDD for business logic, REVIEW.md exact standard template; git init and ignore .story/snapshots/, .story/sessions/, .story/status.json, node_modules/, frontend/dist/, Python caches/venvs and runtime visitor stores. Snapshot, initial handover and setup note record coverage/decisions/tooling. No external issue import. No setup files written pending explicit approval.
Quality level Full pipeline, stateful multi-operator workflow. Explicit enabled flags on all four stages. WRITE_TESTS and TEST enabled backend-only "'`cd backend && pytest`: established by config and collected source, not executed; dependency gaps B2. Frontend WRITE_TESTS and TEST each pending `cd frontend && npm test`: no test source. BUILD enabled `cd frontend && npm run build`: manifest-established, not run. VERIFY disabled pending B2 establishment of backend `cd backend && python -m uvicorn app.main:app`, frontend `cd frontend && npm run dev`, and full-app readiness address; these are proposed, not established. No accidental root npm test defaults; no install/test/build/server execution during setup.
Prior review R2 returned REVISE solely for incorrect count nine when there were eight. Count was corrected to eight in package. This owner'"'s split now adds V2, yielding nine actual tickets. R1 findings already incorporated: all-client offline expiry and explicit B2 launch/readiness ownership.
STORYBLOQ_PLAN"

item.text:
Updated the proposed setup to **nine tickets**. **V1 builds the board page; V2 adds automatic refresh.** Day-end clearing stays in V1 so privacy protection works before polling is implemented.

| Milestone | Ticket | Purpose | Dependencies |
|---|---|---|---|
| Baseline and feasibility | B1: Existing starter | Record verified placeholder and health endpoint as complete | None |
| | B2: Verification and startup | Establish tests, full-app startup and readiness checks | None |
| | C1: Privacy checkpoint | Review interaction sketch and resolve day-end storage policy | None |
| Queue workflow | Q1: Visitor queue API | Add/list visitors with validation and approved retention | B2, C1 |
| | Q2: Take and finish | Handle concurrent claims and completion | Q1 |
| | Q3: Operator controls | Accessible volunteer and repairer workflow | Q2 |
| Live board and acceptance | **V1: Board page** | Initial fetch, waiting/helped display, empty/error states, day-end clearing | Q2 |
| | **V2: Auto-refresh** | Ten-second polling, prevent overlapping requests, show stale state and recover from outages | V1 |
| | C2: Acceptance checkpoint | Demonstrate the complete workflow, refresh and privacy behaviour | Q3, V1, V2 |

V1 will be verified with display, API projection and expiry tests. V2 will have timer-based tests for polling cadence, slow requests, outage recovery, cleanup and polling across midnight.

The first-version boundary remains add, take next, finish and an automatically refreshed board; SMS is deferred. B2 can begin immediately. C1 still resolves the conflict between durable storage and deletion while the server is powered off. Checkpoints are ordinary tickets, not technically enforced approval gates.

The setup package also includes:

- **Project:** Queue board, retaining Vite/JavaScript and FastAPI/Python.
- **Files:** `AGENTS.md`, `RULES.md`, standard `REVIEW.md`, initial handover and coverage note.
- **Git:** initialization and ignores for Storybloq runtime files, dependencies, build outputs, Python caches and visitor data.
- **Roadmap:** three milestones after the default Setup phase, nine tickets and their dependencies.

Quality level: Full pipeline, for the shared queue workflow.

| Stage | Command | Configuration |
|---|---|---|
| Backend WRITE_TESTS / TEST | `cd backend && pytest` | Enabled; command and test source established |
| Frontend WRITE_TESTS / TEST | `cd frontend && npm test` | Pending test sources |
| BUILD | `cd frontend && npm run build` | Enabled; manifest-established |
| VERIFY | Proposed Uvicorn backend plus Vite frontend | Disabled pending B2 startup/readiness work |

No installation, tests, builds or servers were run.
